name: tendencies estimator (sparse Laplace GLMM replaces Stan)
mechanism: estimate.py: latent z = [alpha][beta][a_pos][v_def][s][g|m2] per category; inner Newton on the joint log-density, outer L-BFGS-B on the Laplace log-marginal plus contract priors; OU chain precision tridiagonal; draws from the conditional posteriors (unit chain block inverse, scalar 1/sqrt(H_ii)); unit constant m absorbed (sigma_m = 0).
scope: all 12 sub-models (snap, target, rusher, passer, call, branch, result, td_pass, td_run, gain_pass, gain_run, gain_sack); model_version = sha(MODEL + estimate.py).
fitting_procedure: development data only; cfg = contract.MODEL['estimator']; resume by FitResult.input_sha.

predictions.claim: every sub-model of one real cutoff fits FIT_OK in minutes, not hours
predictions.provenance: development estimate (synthetic 12 sub-models in ~114 s; real rows ~5-10x larger)
predictions.reject_if: any sub-model > 30 min or status != FIT_OK

predictions.claim: fake-data recovery: |est - truth| < 3 max(se, .05) for log sigma_pos, tau, lambda, sigma_def
unit-effect posterior coverage of truth in [0.88, 0.995] at nominal 0.95
m == 0 in every draw (R2: no unit constant)
simulate audits all zero on estimated sub-models; identities read zero

companion_checks: grader diagnostics: converged flag, log_marginal finite
preflight identical to revision 10 (j_prev 1-based, chain stats)
rejection: any prediction fails -> restore revision 14 product files; run log row records the lesson.
